mapper.select: SELECT policy_id, policy_name, description, version, schedule_cron, os_scope, use_yn FROM pmc_policy ORDER BY policy_id
SELECT policy_id, policy_name, description, version, schedule_cron, os_scope, use_yn FROM pmc_policy WHERE policy_id = #{policyId}
SELECT version FROM pmc_policy WHERE policy_id = #{policyId}

SELECT policy_item_id, policy_id, category, mid_category, item_code, item_name, unit, check_cycle, check_method, check_type, judge_criteria, collect_yn, sort_order FROM pmc_policy_item WHERE policy_id = #{policyId} ORDER BY sort_order, policy_item_id

SELECT t.threshold_id, t.policy_item_id, i.item_code, t.level, t.operator, t.compare_value, t.range_low, t.range_high FROM pmc_policy_threshold t JOIN pmc_policy_item i ON i.policy_item_id = t.policy_item_id WHERE i.policy_id = #{policyId}

SELECT svc_target_id, policy_id, svc_name, url, http_method, expected_status, expected_content, timeout_ms, ssl_check_yn, use_yn FROM pmc_policy_svc_target WHERE policy_id = #{policyId} AND use_yn='Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pmc_policy(policy_name, description, version, schedule_cron, os_scope, use_yn, reg_user) VALUES(#{policyName}, #{description}, 1, #{scheduleCron}, #{osScope}, 'Y', 'admin')
mapper.update: UPDATE pmc_policy SET policy_name=#{policyName}, description=#{description}, schedule_cron=#{scheduleCron}, os_scope=#{osScope}, use_yn=#{useYn}, upd_user='admin', upd_dt=now() WHERE policy_id=#{policyId}
UPDATE pmc_policy SET version = version + 1, upd_dt=now() WHERE policy_id=#{policyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pmc_policy_item(policy_id, category, mid_category, item_code, item_name, unit, check_cycle, check_method, check_type, judge_criteria, collect_yn, sort_order) VALUES(#{policyId}, #{category}, #{midCategory}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{unit}, #{checkCycle}, #{checkMethod}, #{checkType}, #{judgeCriteria}, COALESCE(#{collectYn},'Y'), COALESCE(#{sortOrder},0))
INSERT INTO pmc_policy_threshold(policy_item_id, level, operator, compare_value, range_low, range_high) VALUES(#{policyItemId}, #{level}, #{operator}, #{compareValue}, #{rangeLow}, #{rangeHigh})

INSERT INTO pmc_policy_svc_target(policy_id, svc_name, url, http_method, expected_status, expected_content, timeout_ms, ssl_check_yn, use_yn) VALUES(#{policyId}, #{svcName}, #{url}, COALESCE(#{httpMethod},'GET'), COALESCE(#{expectedStatus},200), #{expectedContent}, COALESCE(#{timeoutMs},5000), COALESCE(#{sslCheckYn},'Y'), 'Y')
